description:
Watch Humbird's solo acoustic performance of "All Water"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When the Eaux Claires Festival returned in the summer of 2026, The Current and Radio Milwaukee teamed up for a live broadcast from Shift Coffee Bar in Eau Claire, Wisconsin. On Thursday, July 23, singer-songwriter Siri Undlin — who heads the music project Humbird — performed a set of three songs from her forthcoming album, "Morning When It Comes" releasing Friday, Sept. 25.

Humbird’s album, Morning When It Comes, is available on @NettwerkMusic.

author: The Current
description:
Members of Son Lux describe scoring Bassam Tariq's new film, "Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

“Scoring [films] is a unique privilege we have as a band,” says Son Lux’s Ryan Lott. It’s true: Son Lux have scored a few films, including the Oscar-, Golden Globe- and BAFTA-nominated score they wrote for “Everything Everywhere All at Once.” On Friday, Sept. 25, the new film “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother,” directed by Bassam Tariq and starring Mahershala Ali, is set for release, and Son Lux scored that one, too.

In an interview with The Current’s Zach McCormick, Son Lux’s Rafiq Bhatia explains how scoring “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother” pushed Son Lux to explore new textures. “Our director, Bassam Tariq, really pushed us in the direction of exploring mystery in the sound,” Bhatia says. “I think Son Lux, for all of our interests, we tend towards clarity.”
